results.title: You're The Boss!
results.overview: A municipal sweeper sneezes at an unwanted party and his saliva splashes on the mayor, this creates a big challenge in his mind and he decides to apologize to the mayor.

results.title: A.M.
results.overview: A covert operative races to protect an environmentalist from pursuing assassins.

results.title: Twenty One Pilots: City Walls
results.overview: The elusive rebel leader Clancy faces his ultimate test when he is forced into a direct confrontation with Nico, the ruthless chief bishop. Surrounded by his loyal Bandidos and his closest ally, the Torchbearer, Clancy must decide whether to continue fleeing or stand his ground to break the cycle of captivity once and for all

results.title: Ricky Rapper and the Double
results.overview: Nelly spots Ricky on the street and tries to shout at him, but he can't hear her and disappears around the corner. Aunt Serena is surprised to see Ricky in the shop, exploring the candy shelves, when she should be at home vacuuming. Downstairs neighbour Lennart Lindberg asks Ricky to go fishing, but he never shows up. Is there a Ricky look-alike in town? And if so, where and why has he come to the neighborhood?

results.title: A Diwali Dilemma
results.overview: Overlooked and overworked, Mala has one last night to get things right. When she is forced by her domineering boss to throw a tokenist Diwali party, hilarity ensues as 3 female spirits from her past visit with dire warnings. But are they already too late? A Diwali Dilemma is offers a contemporary twist on a Christmas classic. Charles Dicken's timeless tale is retold and expanded for a new generation and culture.

results.title: PEAUDEDEPART
results.overview: A man goes to meet a prostitute.

results.title: Sanguine
results.overview: A ritualistic meditation on needles, blood and flesh.

results.title: Gangland: The City of Crime
results.overview: A deadly feud emerges between a powerful gangster and his former friend.

results.title: The Non-Actor
results.overview: Elliot is staying with her ex’s new girlfriend while attending a medical trial for her recent, unexplained loss of hearing. As she reconfigures her relationship with her (sonic) environment and herself, an intimate connection sparks between the two women.

results.title: Werewolf Massacre: Carnage of the Night Creatures
results.original_title: Werewolf Massacre: Carnage of the Night Creatures
results.overview: An undead pope hunts a mysterious creature with apocalyptic power, as two outlaws are pulled into a deadly clash of rival forces and hidden agendas

results.title: Lost Flower
results.overview: Washed ashore and taken in to a gothic manor by an unseen masculine force, a lost girl dances in gratitude before him until one day she says no and begins to suspect she might not be the first person to be brought here.

results.title: Yuh Filthy Animal
results.overview: A troubled young man's existence is awakened by a mysterious entity after losing his only brother to a fentanyl overdose.

results.title: The Pledge
results.overview: When three college freshmen- Eva, Jules and Talia- begin their initiation into a new sorority, they quickly realize that it will require more from them than just a simple pledge. Their worst nightmare or everything they've ever wanted?

results.title: Handbook for Superheroes
results.overview: Ten-year-old Lisa, bullied in the decaying town of Rosenhill, finds a book that teaches her to become a superhero. As "Red Mask," she must face a ruthless crime boss and her fears, learning that true heroism lies in compassion and courage.

results.title: The Piccirilli Factor
results.overview: The Piccirilli family settled in New York City and started the largest and most prolific marble carving studio in America. For nearly 50 years, Piccirilli sculptors helped shape the architectural landscapes of Washington and New York through hundreds of monuments, memorials, and artworks, many of which are preserved in museums and private collections.

results.title: Death Among the Pines
results.overview: One night during a heavy rainstorm, a stranded stranger knocks on the door of Angela's country cottage, claiming his car has broken down. Angela lets him in to shelter but soon a police officer arrives, asking questions, amid conducting a manhunt for an escaped criminal. Angela puts two and two together, but is there more to it than meets the eye?

results.title: Naughty America: Guns & Stripes
results.overview: Segment from the larger work Naughty America.

results.title: Death on the Clay Court
results.overview: A rising tennis star is found dead on one of the French Open courts before the women's events. Romaine Fabiot is brought in to investigate with help from the event coordinator Vincent Betti (legendary French tennis player Yannick Noah).

results.title: Incanto
results.overview: On his deathbed, Ludovico entrusts his daughter Margot to the housekeeper, Felicia, asking that the family villa be transformed into an orphanage so that the little girl can grow up in joy with other children. But the wicked Felicia only wants the little girl's assets and not take care of her. With the complicity of her suitor, Max, she exploits the orphaned children and keeps Margot segregated and neglected to the point that the child withdraws into herself and no longer speaks. One night, however, Margot manages to escape and, after overcoming the darkness of the woods, she comes across a circus.
